description: Fondazione IPRES publishes puglia airport aircraft, passenger and freight traffic, 2000–2025. The source reports total aircraft movements, passenger counts and freight tonnes arriving and departing at the main Puglia airports for 2000–2025. Airport management companies supply the data. The workbook descriptor reaches 2025 and the CSV descriptor reaches 2024, so identical coverage across formats is not assumed. Coverage is the Puglia region of Italy. The native catalogue provides CSV and spreadsheet distributions, with some linked visualisations. These alternative representations remain one resource; file contents and data rows were not inspected. The native licence is Creative Commons Attribution without a stated version. The national metadata mirror specifies version 4.0; the native statement remains unversioned. Metadata access is public, while file-use charges and restrictions are not established. Completeness and numerical accuracy are unverified. No specific simulation use is assigned. Related national and regional catalogue representations are treated as the same publication only where their exact source identities match.
